She lit the lamp, settled into his old chair, and opened the first envelope with both hands trembling.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡的街，昨夜的雨藏在砖缝里，偶尔映出出租车的红色尾灯。早餐铺掀起卷帘，蒸汽裹着面香飘过路口。清洁工推车走远，轮子轻轻碾碎寂静。高楼间有一扇窗还亮着，不知谁正醒着。天边渐渐泛白，一只早起的鸟试着叫了一声。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box containing a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule: when you find a box with no smaller box inside, stop."}
